author: Sid911
quote: I bought GTA 6 hoping it would be the best game ever made—the GOAT of all games—and that it would overthrow every other game out there, including any upcoming releases. But instead, Rockstar decided to turn it into a **** cuck simulator.Instead of letting us do some actual killing, stealing, and getting straight into the action, Rockstar decided to make the beginning of the game feel like The Sims. Who the hell wants to spend the first 3–4 hours of the game building and maintaining a house?The story isn't even that interesting. All the missions feel repetitive, the controls are sluggish as ****, and moving around feels like you're underwater. The characters aren't even that lovable or interesting, making it even harder to care about what's going on.Rockstar seems to think that not allowing players to kill protesters, shoot up gay bars, or pick up hookers somehow makes the game more morally acceptable. Bro, this is Grand Theft Auto. This **** is supposed to be part of the experience. You don't need to live a wholesome, peaceful life like some **** cuckold husband. You're supposed to be a criminal, a menace to society, a **** thief—not some law-abiding citizen trying to live a decent life.This is probably the worst game Rockstar Games has ever made. They seriously need to replace the writers responsible for this ****.
